findings.title: python3.12 pip install broken on this host — pyexpat/libexpat ABI mismatch
findings.detail: Python 3.12.13 (Homebrew) was compiled against a newer libexpat than the macOS system provides. All pip install subcommands fail with ImportError on pyexpat.cpython-312-darwin.so. ensurepip also fails. This affects only pip install, not running already-installed packages. Validated with python3.11.15 as fallback.
findings.evidence: ImportError: dlopen(/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.12/3.12.13_2/.../pyexpat.cpython-312-darwin.so): Symbol not found: _XML_SetAllocTrackerActivationThreshold. Referenced from pyexpat.so, Expected in /usr/lib/libexpat.1.dylib
findings.recommendation: brew reinstall python@3.12 or upgrade macOS. Not a package defect.
